entries.headline: Weekly severe flu cases hit 219 with 44 deaths, a five-year high
entries.why: Multiple outlets carry the record weekly toll, and some doctors explicitly urge older high-risk people toward adjuvanted or high-dose vaccines. This shapes the policy debate on how far enhanced-vaccine priority should extend; funding is mostly not stated.
entries.headline_zh: 單週流感重症達219例、44例死亡，創五年新高
entries.why_zh: 多家媒體報導單週重症與死亡創紀錄，部分醫師明確呼籲高齡高風險族群接種含佐劑或高劑量疫苗。此議題影響加強型疫苗優先對象應擴及多廣的政策討論；多數報導未說明經費來源。

entries.headline: Public flu uptake passes 1.91 million in eight days, with health coins credited
entries.why: Public programme (公費): outlets report 1.91 million flu doses and 655,000 COVID doses, and Kaohsiung reports first-week uptake more than 20% above last year. Fast drawdown raises questions about stock pacing before the second stage.
entries.headline_zh: 公費流感疫苗8天接種逾191萬劑，健康幣被認為發揮助力
entries.why_zh: 公費：媒體報導流感疫苗已接種191萬劑、COVID疫苗65.5萬劑，高雄首週接種量較去年增加逾20%。疫苗快速消耗，引發第二階段開打前庫存調配節奏的疑慮。

entries.headline: Users report self-pay flu stock gaps and NT$1,950 prices
entries.why: Self-pay market (自費): a Kaohsiung user says two clinics quoted November for self-pay stock, another post complains of a NT$1,950 price, and Lienchiang opened limited self-pay booking. Separately, users say public-programme (公費) clinics stock only one brand.
entries.headline_zh: 網友反映自費流感疫苗缺貨及NT$1,950價格
entries.why_zh: 自費市場：一名高雄網友表示兩家診所告知自費疫苗要到11月才有貨，另一則貼文抱怨價格達NT$1,950，連江縣則開放有限量自費預約。另有網友表示公費診所僅提供單一廠牌。

entries.headline: Sixteen infants infected in Changhua postpartum care home cluster linked to RSV
entries.why: RSV mentions rose to 16 this week from 4, driven by this cluster report and a post on maternal RSV vaccination evidence. Funding is not stated and there is no official RSV notice yet.
entries.headline_zh: 彰化產後護理之家群聚感染，16名嬰兒染病，與RSV相關
entries.why_zh: 本週RSV討論量由4則增至16則，主要來自此群聚事件報導及一則孕婦接種RSV疫苗實證的貼文。未說明經費來源，目前亦尚無RSV官方公告。

entries.headline: Clinic post promotes adjuvanted flu vaccine with unverified comparative efficacy claims
entries.why: A clinic post claiming 20-30% better protection and 12-month coverage drew notable engagement. Funding is not stated, but it reads as private clinic promotion, a compliance-sensitive area given Taiwan's advertising rules for prescription medicines.
entries.headline_zh: 診所貼文推廣含佐劑流感疫苗，含未經證實的療效比較宣稱
entries.why_zh: 一則診所貼文宣稱保護力高出20-30%、保護期達12個月，互動量可觀。未說明經費來源，但內容屬私人診所推廣；依台灣處方藥廣告規範，屬法規敏感領域。

entries.headline: Side-effect logs and parents' fever and dosing questions gain traction
entries.why: Posts detail multi-day symptoms after a GSK shot and fevers in children, and parents report conflicting clinic advice on toddler second doses. Media also report the first vaccine injury relief award; most posts do not state funding.
entries.headline_zh: 副作用紀錄及家長對發燒與劑次的疑問受到關注
entries.why_zh: 貼文詳述接種GSK疫苗後持續多日的症狀及兒童發燒情形，家長並反映診所對幼兒第二劑的建議不一致。媒體亦報導首件預防接種受害救濟給付案；多數貼文未說明經費來源。

watch.text: Novavax COVID vaccine (150,000 doses) is reported to start, which could reshape co-administration messaging in the dual campaign.
watch.text_zh: 據報Novavax COVID疫苗（15萬劑）將開打，可能改變雙疫苗接種活動中同時接種的溝通訊息。

watch.text: Second stage of the public flu programme opens; watch stock pacing and brand availability after the fast first-week drawdown.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開打；首週快速消耗後，需留意庫存調配節奏與廠牌供應情形。

watch.text: Kaohsiung clinics reportedly expect self-pay flu stock in November, and media say flu activity will not ease until then. Watch for self-pay availability complaints.
watch.text_zh: 據報高雄診所預計11月才有自費流感疫苗，媒體亦指流感疫情要到那時才會趨緩。需留意自費供應相關抱怨。

qa.q: Is the enhanced flu vaccine still part of the conversation?
qa.a: Less than before: enhanced-type mentions fell to 27 this week from 82. Clinicians in news coverage still urge adjuvanted or high-dose vaccines for older high-risk people, linking them to the record severity figures.
qa.q_zh: 加強型流感疫苗仍是討論焦點嗎？
qa.a_zh: 熱度下降：本週加強型相關討論由82則降至27則。新聞報導中，臨床醫師仍呼籲高齡高風險族群接種含佐劑或高劑量疫苗，並連結至創紀錄的重症數據。

qa.q: Is there a flu vaccine supply problem?
qa.a: No official shortage has been announced; the CDC procured 7.05 million doses and uptake passed 1.91 million in eight days. Users report single-brand stock at public-programme clinics, and self-pay stock in Kaohsiung reportedly not until November.
qa.q_zh: 流感疫苗有供應問題嗎？
qa.a_zh: 官方未宣布短缺；疾管署採購705萬劑，8天內接種逾191萬劑。網友反映公費診所僅有單一廠牌，據報高雄自費疫苗要到11月才到貨。

qa.q: Anything moving on RSV or Tdap?
qa.a: RSV mentions rose to 16 this week from 4, driven by a 16-infant cluster at a Changhua postpartum care home and a post on maternal RSV vaccination evidence. Tdap had 7 mentions versus 0, tied to medical-society advice for chronic lung patients, with no official Tdap item.
qa.a_zh: 本週RSV討論量由4則增至16則，主因是彰化產後護理之家16名嬰兒群聚感染及一則孕婦接種RSV疫苗實證的貼文。Tdap有7則（前週0則），均與醫學會對慢性肺病患者的建議有關，無Tdap官方訊息。

policy_notes.why: Pre-launch notice that set the 11 eligible groups, confirmed procurement of standard and enhanced flu vaccines, and introduced the 1,350 health-coin incentive.
policy_notes.why_zh: 開打前公告：訂定11類接種對象，確認採購標準型及加強型流感疫苗，並推出1,350健康幣獎勵。

policy_notes.why: Formal launch confirming 7.05 million flu doses, with enhanced vaccine prioritised for adults 65+ in long-term care, the first public tender win for enhanced brands.
policy_notes.why_zh: 正式開打，確認流感疫苗705萬劑，加強型疫苗優先提供長照機構65歲以上長者，為加強型廠牌首次得標公費採購。

policy_notes.why: The CDC reports uptake above last year and urges high-risk groups to vaccinate early, framing the programme as on track amid rising severe cases.
policy_notes.why_zh: 疾管署指接種量高於去年，呼籲高風險族群儘早接種，在重症增加之際將計畫定調為進展順利。

misinfo.claim: A clinic says adjuvanted flu vaccine gives 20-30% better protection than standard vaccines and lasts a full 12 months
misinfo.note: This is an unverified comparative claim in clinic promotion with notable engagement. Route it to medical and compliance teams, avoid amplifying it, and be ready to clarify approved labelling with clinic stakeholders if asked.
misinfo.claim_zh: 診所稱含佐劑流感疫苗保護力比標準疫苗高20-30%，且可維持整整12個月
misinfo.note_zh: 此為診所推廣中未經證實的比較宣稱，互動量可觀。應轉交醫學及法規遵循團隊，避免擴大傳播，並準備在被詢問時向診所端說明核准仿單內容。

misinfo.claim: Vaccines containing or using viruses endanger seniors, so local calls to vaccinate are harmful
misinfo.note: Low-engagement anti-vaccine post; monitor only, as health authorities and clinicians are already addressing vaccine myths in the media.
misinfo.claim_zh: 含有或使用病毒的疫苗危害長者，因此地方呼籲接種有害
misinfo.note_zh: 低互動的反疫苗貼文；僅需監測，衛生主管機關與臨床醫師已在媒體上澄清疫苗迷思。

misinfo.claim: Getting flu and COVID shots together causes an 'immune storm' and the outbreak is being exploited for elections
misinfo.note: Isolated comment that mixes safety and political framing; monitor in case co-administration doubts spread as the dual campaign continues.
misinfo.claim_zh: 同時接種流感與COVID疫苗會引發「免疫風暴」，疫情正被用於選舉操作
misinfo.note_zh: 零星留言，混雜安全性與政治框架；隨雙疫苗接種活動持續，需監測同時接種疑慮是否擴散。

narratives.title: Infant RSV: care-home cluster and maternal vaccination
narratives.para: A 16-infant infection cluster linked to RSV at a Changhua postpartum care home and posts on maternal RSV vaccination evidence lift infant RSV conversation from a low base.
storylines: rsv risk for infants at school opening
narratives.title_zh: 嬰兒RSV：護理之家群聚與孕婦接種
narratives.para_zh: 彰化產後護理之家16名嬰兒RSV相關群聚感染，以及孕婦接種RSV疫苗實證的貼文，使嬰兒RSV討論從低基期上升。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: RSV volume rose from 4 to 16 items week on week, driven by media reports of 16 infants infected within 20 days at a Changhua postpartum care home and a post summarising European data on maternal RSV vaccination. No item names nirsevimab or infant antibodies.
products.implication: Infant RSV prevention is entering public view through an outbreak in a care setting, and the prevention conversation is currently framed around maternal vaccination and infection control, not infant antibodies.
products.action: Prepare a neutral evidence pack on infant RSV burden and prevention options in care settings; brief pediatric and neonatal experts and be ready for health-authority or media questions if the cluster story develops. No consumer-facing messaging.
who: Postpartum care home operators and regulators
products.signal_zh: RSV討論量週增，由4則增至16則，主因是媒體報導彰化產後護理之家20天內16名嬰兒感染，以及一則彙整歐洲孕婦接種RSV疫苗數據的貼文。無任何內容提及nirsevimab或嬰兒抗體。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒RSV預防因照護機構疫情進入大眾視野，目前預防討論聚焦於孕婦接種與感染管制，而非嬰兒抗體。
products.action_zh: 準備中立的實證資料包，涵蓋嬰兒RSV疾病負擔及照護機構預防選項；向兒科與新生兒科專家簡報，若群聚事件持續發展，準備回應衛生主管機關或媒體提問。不進行消費者溝通。
who_zh: 產後護理之家業者及主管機關

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda, public programme enhanced tender (65+ in long-term care)
products.signal: Enhanced-vaccine volume fell from 82 to 27 items and high-dose from 19 to 12 after launch week. Remaining coverage is severity-driven: doctors urge adjuvanted or high-dose vaccines for high-risk older adults, and one report discusses high-dose for older people with comorbidities. Taiwan CDC says enhanced vaccine is prioritised for 65+ in long-term care.
products.implication: With record severe cases, clinicians are widening the discussion beyond long-term care residents, which may raise access and eligibility questions the public programme does not currently answer. A clinic post making comparative efficacy claims for an adjuvanted vaccine shows the enhanced category is exposed to promotional claims scrutiny.
products.action: Track and log clinic or social claims about enhanced vaccines and maintain a compliance-ready position on advertising rules; prepare burden and uptake evidence for 65+ for policy dialogue with CDC and geriatric experts on enhanced-dose allocation in future tenders.
who: Taiwan Association of Gerontology and Geriatrics
products.sub_zh: Efluelda，公費加強型採購（長照機構65歲以上）
products.signal_zh: 開打週後，加強型疫苗討論量由82則降至27則，高劑量由19則降至12則。剩餘報導以重症為主軸：醫師呼籲高風險長者接種含佐劑或高劑量疫苗，一則報導討論有共病長者接種高劑量疫苗。疾管署表示加強型疫苗優先提供長照機構65歲以上長者。
products.implication_zh: 重症創紀錄之際，臨床醫師將討論範圍擴大至長照住民以外族群，可能引發公費計畫目前未能回應的取得與資格問題。一則診所貼文對含佐劑疫苗提出療效比較宣稱，顯示加強型類別面臨推廣宣稱的檢視風險。
products.action_zh: 追蹤並記錄診所或社群上有關加強型疫苗的宣稱，維持符合廣告規範的法遵立場；準備65歲以上疾病負擔與接種實證，以便與疾管署及老年醫學專家就未來採購的加強型劑量分配進行政策對話。
who_zh: 台灣老年學暨老年醫學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Little this week. Tdap mentions rose from 0 to 7, all tied to medical societies recommending respiratory vaccines, including Tdap and RSV, for people with chronic lung disease such as COPD and asthma. No pertussis outbreak, maternal Tdap or pricing items appeared.
products.implication: The society recommendation is a low-noise opening to place adult boosters within chronic lung disease care, but there is no public pressure or controversy now.
products.action: Monitor the society recommendation's pickup and prepare a short adult-booster evidence summary for pulmonology stakeholders; no reactive work needed.
who: Taiwan Society of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine
products.sub_zh: 成人及孕婦百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 本週動態不多。Tdap討論量由0則增至7則，皆與醫學會建議COPD、氣喘等慢性肺病患者接種包括Tdap與RSV在內的呼吸道疫苗有關。未出現百日咳疫情、孕婦Tdap或價格相關內容。
products.implication_zh: 醫學會建議提供一個低調切入點，可將成人追加劑納入慢性肺病照護，但目前沒有輿論壓力或爭議。
products.action_zh: 監測醫學會建議的擴散情形，並為胸腔科利害關係人準備簡短的成人追加劑實證摘要；無需被動回應作業。
who_zh: 台灣胸腔暨重症加護醫學會

issues.title: Second-stage public flu programme widens eligibility amid record severity
issues.note: Expect demand spikes and questions on brand availability at clinics, plus queries on who can get enhanced vaccines beyond long-term care residents.
issues.title_zh: 重症創紀錄之際，公費流感疫苗第二階段擴大接種對象
issues.note_zh: 預期診所需求激增，並出現廠牌供應問題，以及長照住民以外誰可接種加強型疫苗的詢問。

issues.title: Clinic promotional claims on enhanced flu vaccines draw scrutiny
issues.note: A clinic post with comparative efficacy claims for an adjuvanted vaccine was flagged misleading; similar posts could prompt regulator or media attention across the enhanced category.
issues.title_zh: 診所對加強型流感疫苗的推廣宣稱受到檢視
issues.note_zh: 一則對含佐劑疫苗提出療效比較宣稱的診所貼文被標示為誤導；類似貼文可能引發主管機關或媒體對整個加強型類別的關注。

issues.title: Follow-up on Changhua postpartum care home infant cluster
issues.note: Further reporting or official comment could turn to infant RSV prevention options and infection control in postpartum care homes.
issues.title_zh: 彰化產後護理之家嬰兒群聚後續
issues.note_zh: 後續報導或官方說明可能轉向嬰兒RSV預防選項及產後護理之家感染管制。

self_pay.title: Self-pay stock gaps reported in Kaohsiung
self_pay.note: A user reports two Kaohsiung clinics said self-pay flu vaccine will not be available until November, while Lienchiang County opened limited advance booking for self-pay doses.
self_pay.title_zh: 高雄傳出自費疫苗缺貨
self_pay.note_zh: 一名網友反映兩家高雄診所表示自費流感疫苗要到11月才有，連江縣則開放有限量自費預約。

self_pay.title: Price sensitivity is visible
self_pay.note: A widely engaged post complains about paying NT$1,950 for a self-pay flu shot, and doctors' early-vaccination advice now mentions self-pay as an option.
self_pay.note_zh: 一則高互動貼文抱怨自費流感疫苗需付NT$1,950，醫師的提早接種建議現也將自費列為選項。

self_pay.title: Clinic-led promotion of adjuvanted vaccine
self_pay.note: A clinic post invites people to get an adjuvanted flu vaccine with comparative efficacy claims flagged as misleading; whether the doses are publicly funded or self-pay is not stated.
self_pay.title_zh: 診所主導的含佐劑疫苗推廣
self_pay.note_zh: 一則診所貼文邀請民眾接種含佐劑流感疫苗，其療效比較宣稱被標示為誤導；未說明疫苗為公費或自費。

self_pay.title: No self-pay signal for RSV antibodies or Tdap
self_pay.note: Infant RSV coverage this week concerns a care-home cluster and maternal vaccination evidence, with nothing on clinic stock or prices for infant antibodies or Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: RSV抗體或Tdap無自費相關訊號
self_pay.note_zh: 本週嬰兒RSV報導聚焦護理之家群聚及孕婦接種實證，未見嬰兒抗體或Tdap的診所庫存或價格相關內容。
